test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Three statements in this question and three related conclusions have been given to them, assuming that the things given in the statements are true, it is to decide which conclusions are logical in relation to the statements?

**Statement:** All numbers are categories. Some categories are sequences, some sequences are questions.

**Conclusion:**

i) Some sequences are numbers.

ii) Some questions are category.

iii) All the categories are numbers.
solution:
Given Statements:

All numbers are categories.

Some categories are sequences.

Some sequences are questions.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c61c3a3eea073ee7a949e661d87a7bd9b12333ed36612306ccd981d8f5354f52.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sequences are numbers - False (Because there is no direct relation given between sequences with numbers, so it can be possible only)

II. Some questions are categories - False (Because there is no direct relation given between questions with categories, so it can be possible only)

III. All the categories are numbers - False (Because the statement explicitly states that all numbers are categories, but all Categories are numbers can be possible only)

So, None of the conclusions I, II, and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
